bug.description: test_real_paths_untouched asserts that the real project uploads/ folder is empty (`assert not any(models.DEFAULT_UPLOADS_DIR.iterdir())`). It fails whenever the user has real data (currently 2 png files). This is a test defect: the intent is that tests never write to the real folder, so the test should compare a snapshot of the folder (and logs.db) before and after the suite instead of requiring emptiness. It makes acceptance criterion 12 (all existing tests pass) fail in this environment.
